title: ELN — 'Pillar III: the quiet success story of the NPT RevCon': NPT 제3기둥(원자력 평화적 이용) 분야 성과 분석
snippet: The European Leadership Network analyzed the progress made in Pillar III (peaceful uses of nuclear energy) of the NPT Review Conference, arguing that despite the likely failure to reach consensus on the overall outcome document, there were notable achievements in the peaceful uses domain. This 'quiet success' contrasts with the high-profile failures on disarmament and non-proliferation pillars.
tag_reason: 이전 7일 소스에 동일/유사 항목 없음. NPT RevCon의 부분적 성과라는 새로운 관점 제시. 전체 합의 실패 맥락에서 Pillar III 성과를 분리하여 평가한 분석.
